system_prompt_style.note: Prompt is a format template with {structure}, {current_task}, {filename}, {code}, {lint}; no separate system message seen. Line numbers not given in the evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: For mutation, the agent receives the design specification, current file structure, and a randomly chosen editable code segment.
env_context_strategy.note: The tree is injected via project_tree_view (tree --gitignore) into {structure}. The file segment is chosen randomly by the harness, not by agent navigation.

context_compaction.note: Each call is a single-shot prompt with no history. The history handling code (api.py, llm.py) is not in the bundle.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: 1. The **edited code**, wrapped in triple backticks (```). Limit to **200 lines**.
tool_call_format.note: There are no tools. The model returns code blocks that the harness writes into files. code_as_action is the closest value, but the code is written to files rather than executed.

tool_count.note: No tool definitions exist; there is a fixed response format only.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The editable section is marked with <|EDIT|> and <|END_EDIT|>.
edit_primitive.note: The model rewrites the marked section, and may add one full new file.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema exists; the response format is hand-written in the prompt.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or full source grep is available in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If accepted, the candidate is added to the phylogenetic graph as a new node with appropriate parent edges. Otherwise, the proposal is discarded.
loop_primitives.note: The system is an evolutionary loop: mutate or crossover, then lint and judge, then accept or discard, with a fixup prompt. It runs a population of parallel agents.

planning_granularity.note: Human-written stage documents in design_doc supply the current task.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: EvoGit deploys a population of independent coding agents, each proposing edits to a shared code-base without centralized coordination, explicit message passing, or shared mem-ory.
multi_agent_topology.note: Coordination between agents is stigmergic, through Git.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This decentralized architecture enables fully asynchronous agent operation without centralized scheduling or inter-agent communication.

human_in_loop.note: A periodic human product manager reviews and prunes or promotes branches (paper Sec. 2.4).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: agents do not retain long-term memory. All progress and decisions are recorded in the version graph itself.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: EvoGit’s version graph serves as both memory and medium
long_term_memory.note: The Git repository persists across runs. file_notes is the closest value.

state_persistence.note: The run loop (api.py) is not in the bundle. A clean_start config field exists, which hints at possible resume.

self_verification.evidence_quote: If after this change, the code is relatively better, please respond with "good", otherwise, please respond with "bad".
self_verification.note: Linting runs via get_linter_feedback (eslint/next build, pyright) in python-impl/evogit/utils/prompt.py.

retry_policy.note: Retry is capped for merges; a fixup prompt also exists.

rollback.evidence_quote: Every edit is recorded as a commit, enabling inspection, repro-ducibility, and rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: A population of 16 autonomous coding agents operates in parallel, each performing up to 120 iterations.

cost_controls.note: The config model has no budget field, but llm.py was not provided.

timeouts.note: The timeout is likely for evaluation commands.

execution_isolation.note: Linter and build commands run through subprocess. An optional bubblewrap sandbox (bubblewrap_run.sh) exists; its default is unknown.

filesystem_access.note: The model does not execute actions; the harness writes files.

network_policy.evidence_quote: npm install --silent && npx next lint -f codeframe

permission_model.note: The model emits no commands; there are no per-action permissions.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every edit, merge, and decision is recorded as an immutable Git commit.
tracing.note: The Git commit history serves as the trace.

replayability.evidence_quote: This enables transparent audit-ing, reproducibility, and replay of the entire development trajectory.

eval_hooks.note: The evaluation command is task-specific; no benchmark runner is present.

guardrails.note: The lint/judge gate rejects bad changes.

target_domain.evidence_quote: decentralized multi-agent framework for collaborative software development

open_source.note: The LICENSE file is present, but its text is not in the bundle.
